key_amendment_citation: Stats. 2013, Ch. 444, Sec. 5 (AB 658) — added $1,000 nominal damages, financial-gain penalty track, HIPAA affirmative defense
notes: The 2013 amendment is the critical structural change: it added the $1,000 nominal damages floor (removing the actual-harm barrier) and the $250,000 + disgorgement track for financial-gain violations. The 1981 original text is outstanding work.
